I don’t even know how to start this, thank you. Truly.
Ninety-nine dollars is an enormous gesture, and I don’t take it lightly for a second. Knowing someone would support the channel like that, just to say “thanks,” means more than I can put into a comment.
These long, quiet videos exist so people can work, rest, think, or just have something gentle in the room. If this music has been that for you, even a little, then you’ve already given me more than enough. The Super Thanks on top of that is just… overwhelming, in the best way.
Thank you for listening, for staying, and for being this generous. It keeps the lights on, it keeps the long videos coming, and it reminds me why I make this in the first place.
Take care, and I hope the next ones keep you company just as well.
